class MultilineContinuationErrorTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    """Regression tests for MultilineContinuationError, the error raised
    when a valueless option is followed by an indented line.

    allows no-value options, so every case here needs
    ``allow_no_value=True``.

    def _make(self, config_class):
        return config_class(allow_no_value=True)

    def _ini(self):
        # line 1: section header
        # line 2: valueless option
        # line 3: indented line, i.e. a continuation of "option"
        return "[section]\noption\n    continuation\n"

    def test_multiline_continuation_error_raised_by_read_string(self):
        for config_class in (configparser.RawConfigParser,
                             configparser.ConfigParser):
            with self.subTest(config_class=config_class):
                cf = self._make(config_class)
                with self.assertRaises(
                        configparser.MultilineContinuationError) as cm:
                    cf.read_string(self._ini())
                e = cm.exception
                self.assertIsInstance(e, configparser.ParsingError)
                self.assertIsInstance(e, configparser.Error)
                self.assertEqual(e.args, ('<string>', 3, '    continuation\n'))
                self.assertEqual(e.source, '<string>')
                self.assertEqual(e.lineno, 3)
                self.assertEqual(e.line, '    continuation\n')
                self.assertEqual(e.errors, [(3, '    continuation\n')])
                self.assertEqual(
                    str(e),
                    "Source contains parsing errors: '<string>'\n"
                    "\t[line  3]:     continuation\n")
